claims.statement: Management states that the company does not provide very specific guidance on store additions.
claims.quote: As has been the policy of the Company, we do not give very specific guidance on how many stores we will add.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management states the goal to either do better than past store expansion performance or at least maintain it.
claims.quote: however, our endeavour is always to be better than what we have done in the past or at least maintain what we have done in the past.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management states a gross margin target of not wanting to earn more than 15%.
claims.quote: gross margins are something that is sacrosanct. We don't want to earn more than 15% and below that whatever happens is a factor of market forces.
claims.speaker: management

facts.quote: We have 324 stores. A lot of repair and maintenance happens.

facts.statement: Miscellaneous expenses primarily comprise bank credit card commissions, repair and maintenance, and advertisements.
facts.quote: This is a combination of primarily three large heads. One is the bank credit card commission charge that you pay to the credit card company or the banks. Then there's also a lot of repair and maintenance that happens in all our stores. We have 324 stores. A lot of repair and maintenance happens. And also, advertisement.
